replies.author: Pocketstar
replies.text:
Kamika242 Perhaps you can enable the shortcut for the volume buttons for Talkback. This way, you can simply hold the vol+ and vol- at the same time for a second or two, and it will instantly enable or disable Talkback. So if ever it happens again, the "cure" would be to hold the vol-/vol+ buttons.

You can find it in Settings/Accessibility/Talkback/Talkback shortcut.

Furthermore, you can completely disable the Talkback app in app settings. (Enable "show system" in order to see the app)
